{{Quote|Mutinous traitors! Lord Vader will hear of this!|The Captain berates his former subordinates|<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>}}
A '''captain''' was the commander of an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]]. He was among the few survivors of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]]. He reminded the few forces that remained under his command that his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was still in need of repairs, much to the amusement of [[Tyber Zann]]. The [[Captain/Legends|captain]] berated [[Imperial Tartan cruiser defectors|the crewmembers]] of four traitorous [[Tartan-class patrol cruiser|''Tartan''-class patrol cruisers]], saying that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] would know of their treachery. He was killed when the firepower of the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium's]] forces destroyed his ship.
